review_text: No charger in the box, had to buy one separately.
Gets hot while gaming, frame rate drops after 20 minutes.
Battery drains fast on 5G, needs charging by evening.
Phone feels hot when charging, a bit worrying.
Display colours are great for the price.
Fast and smooth, apps open instantly.
Worth the price, great value at this cost.
The display is stunning and very bright outdoors.
A bit expensive for what you get, not worth it at launch price.
Performance is smooth, no lag in daily use.
Battery easily lasts a full day with normal use.
